# Fix-round-1 F4: vendored field names and enum values for the legacy
# generateContent/streamGenerateContent surface, extracted from the fetched
# `https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content.md.txt`'s literal "JSON
# representation" code blocks and enum tables (never from prose), plus
# `https://ai.google.dev/api/caching.md.txt`'s FunctionCallingConfig/Mode
# section for `allowedFunctionNames`/tool-choice mode values -- see
# docs/decisions/2026-08-27-google-genai-spec-verification.md Divergence 1
# and fix-round-1 F4 for why `caching.md.txt`, not `generate-content.md.txt`,
# is the correct citation for that second group.
#
# Field names (Content, Part, FunctionCall, FunctionResponse, Tool,
# FunctionDeclaration, the GenerationConfig/ThinkingConfig subset this codec
# sets, Candidate, PromptFeedback, UsageMetadata):
contents
parts
role
text
thought
thoughtSignature
functionCall
name
args
id
functionResponse
response
tools
functionDeclarations
description
parameters
toolConfig
generationConfig
maxOutputTokens
stopSequences
temperature
topP
thinkingConfig
thinkingBudget
systemInstruction
candidates
content
finishReason
promptFeedback
blockReason
usageMetadata
promptTokenCount
candidatesTokenCount
cachedContentTokenCount
# `Content.role` values (verified: "Must be either 'user' or 'model'"):
user
model
# `FunctionResponse.response` is caller's-choice-of-key; "output"/"error" are
# this codec's own convention (the fetched doc's own note: "if the function
# call failed... the response can have an error key"), not spec-mandated
# field names -- included here anyway since they ARE the literals the code
# matches on, and neither is a real risk of being spec-wrong (they're chosen
# by us, not read off the wire).
output
error
# `FunctionCallingConfig`/`Mode` (`caching.md.txt`) -- full enum, not just
# the two values this codec currently sends, per fix-round-1 F10's lesson
# (don't vendor only the current subset of a closed enum):
functionCallingConfig
allowedFunctionNames
mode
MODE_UNSPECIFIED
AUTO
ANY
NONE
VALIDATED
